name: Piper Yann

intro.text: I play the bombard, my friend plays the biniou, a little bagpipe. In Brittany pipers come in pairs, like gendarmes. Ready?

win: Yec'hed mat! Good health to you, and to your team.
after: Breton sonneurs often play in pairs, a bombard (a loud double-reed pipe) answering a biniou (a small bagpipe), call and response.
